entities.summary: The Church of the Girolamini, also known as the Church of Saint Philip Neri, is a church and ecclesiastical complex in Naples, Italy. It stands directly across from the Cathedral of Naples on Via Duomo. Its façade faces the square and the street of the same name, opposite Santa Maria della Colonna. The complex is located one block west of Via Duomo.
